items.title_en: Qwen 3.8 27B
items.title_zh: Qwen 3.8-27B 模型
items.summary_en: Qwen 3.8-27B FP8 marks another step toward accessible, efficient LLMs. The 27B parameter model is optimized for FP8 inference, enabling faster runs on commodity GPUs and lower memory footprints, helping hobbyists and small teams experiment with large models.
items.summary_zh: Qwen 3.8-27B FP8 提供更高效的推理，27亿参数在普通显卡上也能更快地跑，显存需求更低，便于个人和小团队尝试大模型。

items.title_en: Firefox is now the last major browser that still supports uBlock Origin
items.title_zh: Firefox 仍是最后一个主流浏览器继续支持 uBlock Origin
items.summary_en: Firefox remains the last major browser to support uBlock Origin, a notable contrast to recent policy shifts elsewhere. The situation affects ad-blocking workflows and browser-extension ecosystems.
items.summary_zh: Firefox 仍是最后一个主流浏览器继续支持 uBlock Origin，与其他浏览器近年的策略变化形成对照，影响广告拦截工作流与扩展生态。

items.title_en: Magnitude 7.7 Earthquake – 68 km NNW of Ende, Indonesia
items.title_zh: 印尼 Ende 以北偏西北68公里处发生7.7级地震
items.summary_en: A powerful magnitude-7.7 earthquake struck offshore about 68 km NNW of Ende, Indonesia. Early reports suggest strong shaking in the region and possible tsunami advisories, underscoring the continual seismic risk in Indonesia's Ring of Fire and the need for coastal preparedness.
items.summary_zh: 印尼 Ende 以北偏西北约68公里的海域发生7.7级地震，震源强度强烈。初步评估显示该区域可能出现海啸警报，强调该地震带的高风险及需要迅速的区域应急准备。

items.title_en: Every Fucking Website (2020)
items.title_zh: 2020 年的 Every Fucking Website：所有网站清单
items.summary_en: An archival project cataloging 2020-era websites offers a snapshot of the web's breadth and variety at the time, highlighting how the internet has evolved since then.
items.summary_zh: 这是一份整理自 2020 年的网页索引，展现当时互联网的规模与多样性，为理解网络生态的演变提供参考。

items.title_en: Going Dark, and the era of law enforcement hacking
items.title_zh: 走向黑暗：执法黑客时代
items.summary_en: As privacy tools intensify, investigators face a going dark world where encryption thwarts traditional surveillance, pushing a shift toward legal and technical hacking measures. The article analyzes the implications for security design, policy, and the balance between privacy and public safety.
items.summary_zh: 随着隐私工具日益普及，执法调查渐渐进入去光的信息环境，传统监听与取证手段受到挑战。文章评估隐私、安全与执法能力之间的张力，并探讨对安全设计与相关政策的影响。

items.title_en: Jane Street suffers $15B hit after meltdown at Situational Awareness
items.title_zh: Jane Street 遭遇情境感知崩溃，损失高达150亿美元
items.summary_en: Jane Street reportedly faced a $15 billion loss tied to a meltdown during a situational awareness exercise, underscoring the risks of models and risk controls in high frequency trading. The incident prompts scrutiny of risk management and real time decision systems in finance.
items.summary_zh: 据报Jane Street 在一次情境感知演练中遭遇重大亏损，损失达150亿美元，凸显风险管理和实时决策系统在量化交易中的挑战。

items.title_en: RISC-V: They should have known better
items.title_zh: RISC-V：他们本应做得更好
items.summary_en: A provocative critique of the RISC-V ecosystem, arguing that practical challenges such as toolchain maturity, ecosystem support, and performance realities were underestimated. The piece calls for more pragmatic planning as RISC-V scales.
items.summary_zh: 对 RISC-V 生态提出批评，认为工具链成熟度、生态支持与性能现实等挑战被低估。文章呼吁在扩展 RISC-V 的同时更务实地处理实现与产业落地的问题。

items.title_en: Why does Opus 5 feel worse to work with?
items.title_zh: 为什么 Opus 5 的使用感更差？
items.summary_en: An analysis argues that Opus 5 feels worse to work with due to UX and workflow frictions common in enterprise software. It points to inconsistent interfaces, onboarding friction, and brittle customization that hamper daily productivity, despite feature-rich capabilities.
items.summary_zh: 对 Opus 5 的工作体验为何较差进行了分析，指向用户体验不一致、工作流阻塞和隐藏的复杂性等问题，影响日常生产力。该案例也折射出企业级软件在可用性方面的不足，即便功能强大也难以落地。

items.title_en: GLM-5.3: Frontier coding with emergent cyber capabilities
items.title_zh: GLM-5.3：具备涌现性网络能力的前沿编码
items.summary_en: GLM-5.3 expands the frontier of AI-assisted coding by showcasing emergent cyber capabilities that go beyond standard copilots. It hints at advanced code generation, reasoning, and integration skills that could reshape developer workflows and security tooling.
items.summary_zh: GLM-5.3 展示了超越常规编码助手的涌现性网络能力，推动代码生成、推理与系统集成等方面的进步。此举可能重新定义开发者工作流以及相关的安全工具链。

items.title_en: Stop sending me huge PRs; a rant
items.title_zh: 别再发给我超大 PR 的抱怨
items.summary_en: A critique of oversized pull requests, arguing for smaller, more incremental changes and better review discipline. The piece advocates practical guidelines to keep reviews efficient and code quality high.
items.summary_zh: 批评过长的合并请求对代码评审效率的负面影响，主张以更小的、分阶段的提交来提高审阅效率和代码质量。并提出实现高效评审的实践建议。

items.title_en: Google is making private AI practical with homomorphic encryption
items.title_zh: 谷歌通过同态加密让私有 AI 变得更实用
items.summary_en: Google outlines how homomorphic encryption can enable private AI workloads, allowing computations on encrypted data without exposing raw inputs, a promising privacy-preserving path for AI.
items.summary_zh: 谷歌阐述同态加密如何使私有 AI 工作负载成为现实，在不暴露原始输入的情况下对加密数据进行计算，为隐私保护的 AI 研究与应用提供新路径。

items.title_en: Seven books I keep close because I love them
items.title_zh: 我最珍爱的七本书
items.summary_en: The author shares seven books they keep close, offering brief reflections on why each title resonates and what it reveals about their tastes. The list gives quick, idiosyncratic recommendations across genres.
items.summary_zh: 作者选出七本近来最为珍爱的书，简要说明它们为何动人以及它们反映的阅读偏好。此清单提供跨题材的短小但有力的推荐。

items.title_en: RustDesk now supports true unattended remote access on Wayland
items.title_zh: RustDesk 在 Wayland 下现在支持无人值守远程访问
items.summary_en: Wayland support unlocks true unattended remote access in RustDesk, letting admins reach headless machines without an active session. The update broadens RustDesk's use cases for server maintenance and remote work on Linux desktops.
items.summary_zh: Wayland 的支持让 RustDesk 实现真正的无人值守远程访问，管理员可在无会话的情况下远程管理。此更新扩展了 Linux 桌面环境下的服务器维护与远程工作场景。

items.title_en: In Australia, a home battery boom has helped cut wholesale power prices
items.title_zh: 在澳大利亚，家庭储能热潮把批发电价降了一半
items.summary_en: Growing home battery and solar adoption is flattening the electricity demand curve, letting households store cheap energy for use during peak hours. That shift has helped cut wholesale power prices by roughly half, illustrating how distributed energy resources can dampen market volatility while boosting consumer resilience.
items.summary_zh: 家用储能与屋顶太阳能的快速普及正在拉平用电需求曲线，使峰谷价差减少。结果促使批发电价大约下降了一半，凸显分布式能源对市场波动的缓冲作用，并提升家庭能源自主性。

items.title_en: Count Binface receives over a quarter of votes in Clacton by-election
items.title_zh: Count Binface 在 Clacton 补选中获得超过四分之一票
items.summary_en: A satirical candidate named Count Binface performed surprisingly well in Clacton by-election, capturing about a quarter of votes. This shows how protest voting and novelty campaigns can shake up local races and reflect voter appetite for alternatives to major parties.
items.summary_zh: 讽刺性候选人 Count Binface 在 Clacton 补选中出人意料地表现亮眼，获得约四分之一的选票。这凸显了抗议投票和新奇竞选在地方选举中的冲击力，以及选民对主要政党以外选项的需求。

items.title_en: The case for overhauling American science
items.title_zh: 全面改革美国科学的必要性
items.summary_en: The Economist argues for a structural overhaul of American science policy, including funding, governance, and incentives to accelerate innovation. The piece outlines reforms to better align research with societal needs and global competitiveness.
items.summary_zh: 《经济学人》呼吁改革美国科学政策，涵盖资助、治理与激励机制，以推动创新更高效地落地。文中提出系统性改革以提升研究方向对社会需求和全球竞争力的贡献。

items.title_en: AI by Hand
items.title_zh: AI by Hand 手作式人工智能
items.summary_en: AI by Hand explores a human-centered approach to AI, emphasizing user control, transparent workflows, and responsible AI design. The project advocates blending AI capabilities with human oversight rather than replacing it.
items.summary_zh: AI by Hand 聚焦以人为本的 AI 方法，强调用户控制、透明工作流与负责任的 AI 设计，主张将 AI 能力与人类监督结合，而非取代人类。

items.title_en: France's top court blocks social media ban for under-15s
items.title_zh: 法国最高法院阻止未满 15 岁社交媒体禁令
items.summary_en: France's top court ruling blocks a ban on under-15s using social media, citing freedom of expression concerns and privacy rights. The decision shapes how age-restriction policies are drafted across Europe.
items.summary_zh: 法国最高法院裁定禁止未满 15 岁使用社交媒体的禁令，基于表达自由和隐私权等考量；此判决将影响欧洲范围内的年龄限制政策。

items.title_en: Introducing Toast 1
items.title_zh: Toast 1 首发
items.summary_en: Toast 1 introduces a new concept/project, outlining its aims, core ideas, and earliest capabilities. It signals the start of a new tool or framework and invites early feedback from the community.
items.summary_zh: Toast 1 是一个新项目的首发，概述了目标、核心思想与初步能力，标志着一个新工具/框架的起步，并鼓励社区早期反馈。

items.title_en: Gemini 3.7 Flash
items.title_zh: Gemini 3.7 快闪版
items.summary_en: Gemini 3.7 Flash extends the Gemini line with a lighter, faster variant optimized for low latency and smaller memory usage. It underscores Google’s ongoing push to edge-ready AI and developer-friendly tooling for large models.
items.summary_zh: Gemini 3.7 快闪版在保持核心能力的同时，提供更轻量、低延迟的推理性能，降低内存占用，便于边缘部署。此举显示谷歌在大模型的边缘化与开发者工具方面的持续推进。

items.title_en: Maximizing the value of your Claude Code sessions
items.title_zh: 最大化 Claude Code 会话的价值
items.summary_en: Claude Code sessions can be more productive by following best practices: structured prompts, proper context management, and integration with local tools. The guide helps users extract more value from their coding interactions with Claude.
items.summary_zh: 遵循结构化提示、良好上下文管理及与本地工具的整合，可以让 Claude Code 会话更高效。本文提供实现高产出的实用技巧。

items.title_en: eigendrum
items.title_zh: eigendrum：圆形膜的本征音响与互动
items.summary_en: Eigendrum explores the acoustic eigenmodes of a circular drum and maps them to audio visual experiences, blending physics with interactive art. The project demonstrates how simple physical systems can generate rich, tunable soundscapes.
items.summary_zh: eigendrum 将圆形鼓的本征模态与音视频交互结合，呈现物理系统在声响中的丰富表现。该项目展示了简单物理系统如何创造可控且富有层次的声音。

items.title_en: I turned my RSS feeds into an e-ink newspaper to stop reading on my phone
items.title_zh: 我把 RSS 源变成电子纸报纸以戒手机阅读
items.summary_en: An experiment turning RSS feeds into an e-ink newspaper to curb phone-centric reading demonstrates how reformatting information can reduce digital distraction and improve focus.
items.summary_zh: 将 RSS 信息转成电子纸报纸以减少手机依赖，展示了通过改造信息呈现形式来降低数字干扰、提升专注度的思路。

items.title_en: Accelerating GPT-5.6 Sol Ultrafast
items.title_zh: 加速 GPT-5.6 的 Sol Ultrafast
items.summary_en: Cerebras details substantial speedups for GPT-5.6 on its Sol Ultrafast platform, combining specialized hardware with software optimizations to accelerate inference. The result underscores how hardware-software co-design can dramatically shrink response times for cutting-edge LLMs.
items.summary_zh: Cerebras 在 Sol Ultrafast 平台上为 GPT‑5.6 提供显著加速，结合定制硬件与软件优化以缩短推理时间。硬件与软件的协同设计再次推动下一代大模型的实用性。

items.title_en: DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing update
items.title_zh: DeepSeek 峰谷定价更新
items.summary_en: The update introduces refined pricing tiers for peak and off-peak usage, potentially lowering costs for off-peak workloads and nudging customers to shift traffic. It also adds new API controls and analytics to monitor demand patterns.
items.summary_zh: 该更新引入更细化的峰谷定价策略，鼓励在非高峰时段执行工作负载，降低成本并提升容量利用率。同时提供新的 API 控制和数据分析，帮助用户把握需求模式。

items.title_en: Spaghettifying DRAM
items.title_zh: 将 DRAM 拆解为意面状结构
items.summary_en: Spaghettifying DRAM examines how unusual or chaotic memory layouts can affect latency, bandwidth, and reliability. The discussion highlights the ongoing tension between memory hardware complexity and software efficiency, suggesting approaches for hardware-aware optimization.
items.summary_zh: Spaghettifying DRAM 探讨了非传统、混乱的内存布局如何影响延迟、带宽与可靠性。该讨论凸显了内存硬件复杂性与软件效率之间的矛盾，并提出面向硬件的优化思路。

items.title_en: DeepSeek Harness developer preview
items.title_zh: DeepSeek Harness 框架
items.summary_en: DeepSeek Harness appears to be a framework around DeepSeek AI to run experiments and benchmark performance. It could help teams standardize evaluation, compare model behavior, and improve reproducibility in AI workflows. This development comes at a time when measurable benchmarks are increasingly important for agent-powered systems.
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek Harness 似乎是围绕 DeepSeek AI 的一个用于实验运行与性能基准的框架。它有助于团队标准化评估、对比模型行为，并提升 AI 工作流的可重复性。随着对代理系统的基准衡量需求提升，这类工具的重要性也在上升。

items.title_en: Study links coffee consumption to metabolic health and sex hormones
items.title_zh: 研究发现咖啡摄入与代谢健康及性激素水平相关
items.summary_en: The study reports associations between coffee intake and metabolic health markers as well as sex hormone levels, with potential differences between men and women. While not proving causation, findings hint at caffeine’s nuanced role in metabolism and endocrine function.
items.summary_zh: 研究显示咖啡摄入与代谢健康指标及性激素水平存在关联，男性与女性之间可能存在差异。结果并非因果，但提示咖啡因在代谢与内分泌功能中的作用具备细微差别。

items.title_en: The TEMU-Fication of Software, Digital Goods and Services
items.title_zh: 软件、数字商品与服务的 TEMU 化
items.summary_en: The piece analyzes how Temu-like marketplaces disrupt software and digital goods by commoditizing access, accelerating downloads, and driving margin pressure. It discusses implications for developers and distributive platforms, including pricing pressure, copy protection, and user acquisition strategies.
items.summary_zh: 文章解析像 Temu 这样的市场如何通过商品化获取软件和数字商品的低价与快速分发，压缩利润率并改变用户获取方式。对开发者、发行平台及定价、版权保护和分发策略提出了影响与思考。

items.title_en: Show HN: LuaCAD – Parametric CAD Scripted in Lua
items.title_zh: Show HN：LuaCAD——用 Lua 脚本实现的参数化 CAD
items.summary_en: LuaCAD brings parametric CAD to the browser/coding world by scripting in Lua, enabling programmable design workflows and rapid experimentation.
items.summary_zh: LuaCAD 将参数化 CAD 带入 Lua 脚本世界，支持通过脚本进行参数化设计、实现可编程的设计工作流。

items.title_en: Anthropic Risk August 2026 [pdf]
items.title_zh: Anthropic 风险报告 2026 年 8 月 [PDF]
items.summary_en: Anthropic's risk report for August 2026 analyzes AI safety challenges and mitigations, highlighting risk signals and security considerations for large-scale models.
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 的 2026 年 8 月风险报告评估了 AI 安全挑战与应对措施，重点揭示风险信号及大模型的安全考量。

items.title_en: Show HN: Mole – Deep research agent for your terminal
items.title_zh: Show HN：Mole——为终端设计的深度研究助手
items.summary_en: Mole bills itself as a terminal-based deep research agent, enabling rapid querying, synthesis, and note-taking within the shell. It aims to streamline exploratory work for researchers and power users.
items.summary_zh: Mole 是一个在终端中运行的深度研究助手，支持快速查询、信息整合与笔记，旨在提升研究与高阶用户的工作效率。

items.title_en: Every exterior shot in The Taking of Pelham 123
items.title_zh: 《把人带走123》外景拍摄点全解析
items.summary_en: An exhaustive look at all exterior filming locations used in The Taking of Pelham 123, mapping routes and urban landscapes that shaped the film's chase scenes. The piece reveals how location choices contribute to its city noir mood.
items.summary_zh: 对《把人带走123》所有外景拍摄点进行了系统整理，映射了拍摄路线与城市景观。地点选择如何塑造了影片的城市气质与叙事节奏。

items.title_en: Understanding is the new bottleneck
items.title_zh: 理解力成为新的瓶颈
items.summary_en: As systems scale, human understanding of data, models, and outcomes becomes the limiting factor. The post argues that tooling for interpretability and governance will determine how fast teams can move from insight to action. Without better explainability, even powerful models can't reliably translate gains into business value.
items.summary_zh: 随着系统规模扩大，对数据、模型和结果的理解成为制约因素。文章认为，提升可解释性和治理能力的工具将决定团队如何快速把洞察转化为行动。若缺乏更好的可解释性，强大的模型也难以可靠地把收益转化为商业价值。

items.title_en: New Lower and Upper Bounds for the Grothendieck Constant
items.title_zh: Grothendieck 常数的新上下界
items.summary_en: The paper tightens asymptotic bounds on the Grothendieck constant, advancing understanding in functional analysis and related computation. Improvements in constants can influence complexity estimates in various math and CS problems.
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文改进了 Grothendieck 常数的上下界推导，对泛函分析和相关计算领域具有理论意义。更紧的界限可能影响多种问题的复杂度估计。

items.title_en: Choose Boring Technology (2015)
items.title_zh: 选择无聊的技术（2015）
items.summary_en: The piece argues for choosing boring technology—reliable, boring options with long lifespans and easier maintenance over flashy, fad-driven stacks. It stresses simplicity, risk reduction, and sustainable engineering choices in real-world deployments.
items.summary_zh: 文章主张在技术选型上优先选择“无聊但可靠”的方案，强调长期维护、稳定性和风险降低。通过对比示例，提出在真实部署中应避免盲目追逐热潮。

items.title_en: Apple proposes to take a 15% cut of purchases made outside the App Store
items.title_zh: 苹果拟对 App Store 之外购买收取 15% 提成
items.summary_en: Apple proposes a 15% cut on purchases made outside the App Store, reigniting debates about platform power, developer economics, and app discovery in the mobile ecosystem.
items.summary_zh: 苹果提出对在应用商店外进行的购买抽取 15% 的分成，引发关于平台垄断、开发者经济与应用发现的讨论。

items.title_en: Mistral OCR 4.1
items.title_zh: Mistral OCR 4.1
items.summary_en: Mistral OCR 4.1 introduces improvements in optical character recognition, including higher accuracy, better multi-language support, and refined layout analysis. It expands capability for document processing, forms, and scanned media in production pipelines.
items.summary_zh: Mistral OCR 4.1 在识别准确度、多语言支持和版面分析方面有改进，提升了文档处理的效率。对生产线中的表单和扫描件处理具有实用价值。

items.title_en: What You Gain by Building Your Own Game Engine
items.title_zh: 自己打造游戏引擎能带来什么
items.summary_en: Building your own game engine forces you to confront low-level tradeoffs: rendering abstractions, memory management, and tooling. You gain deep understanding, portability, and control that pay off in longer-term projects, even if you sacrifice some rapid iteration.
items.summary_zh: 自建引擎需要直面底层权衡：渲染、内存管理与工具链。尽管代价是放慢迭代，你会获得更深的理解、可移植性与对项目长期方向的掌控。

items.title_en: Gloomberb
items.title_zh: Gloomberb
items.summary_en: Gloomberb signals a project from gloom.sh, but details remain scarce from the title alone. It hints at a new developer tool or service that may be announced or evolved soon.
items.summary_zh: Gloomberb 暗示 gloom.sh 的一个新项目，但从标题本身很难判定具体内容。这可能是一个新的开发工具或服务，预计将很快有更多信息。

items.title_en: Cursor is now a part of SpaceX
items.title_zh: Cursor 加入 SpaceX
items.summary_en: Cursor joins SpaceX, signaling potential integration of Cursor's tools into SpaceX's workflows and a boost to automation and collaboration within the company.
items.summary_zh: Cursor 加入 SpaceX，预示其工具将嵌入太空公司工作流，提升自动化与协作能力。

items.title_en: Hello, me. It's been a while
items.title_zh: 你好，我，是我。好久不见。
items.summary_en: Hello, me. It's been a while
items.summary_zh: 这是作者在长期休笔后回归的个人更新。

items.title_en: Earth.nullschool.net
items.title_zh: Earth.nullschool.net 地球实时风场可视化
items.summary_en: Earth.nullschool.net provides a global, interactive visualization of atmospheric data—wind, temperature, and currents—across the planet in real time.
items.summary_zh: Earth.nullschool.net 提供全球范围内的实时大气数据可视化，交互式查看风、温度、海流等信息。

items.title_en: Self-hosted web push Cloudflare Worker, works on iOS
items.title_zh: 自托管的 Web Push：Cloudflare Worker，iOS 也能用
items.summary_en: A self-hosted web push setup using Cloudflare Worker claims iOS compatibility, reducing reliance on third-party push services and improving privacy controls.
items.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Worker 的自托管 Web Push 方案声称支持 iOS，减少对第三方推送服务的依赖，并提高隐私控制能力。

items.title_en: Nine PBS sues Iron Mountain over blocked access to archival data
items.title_zh: Nine PBS 因被限制访问档案数据而起诉 Iron Mountain
items.summary_en: The broadcaster alleges that Iron Mountain blocked access to archival data, prompting legal action. The case highlights how vendor-controlled archives intersect with public-access requirements and preservation obligations. If the suit succeeds, it could influence data governance policies for libraries, broadcasters, and other institutions.
items.summary_zh: 该机构指控 Iron Mountain 阻断对档案数据的访问，提起诉讼。此案凸显了由厂商控制的档案与公开访问需求及保存义务之间的矛盾。若胜诉，可能影响图书馆、广播机构等组织的数据治理政策。

items.title_en: Ordinary Abundance
items.title_zh: 日常的丰盈
items.summary_en: A meditation on abundance in tech and life, challenging scarcity mindsets and highlighting ways to build resilient systems, generous collaboration, and sustainable design.
items.summary_zh: 聚焦在技术与生活中的丰富性，挑战匮乏思维，倡导更可持续、容错与协作友好的设计与实现方式。

items.title_en: Bluesky Protocol Services
items.title_zh: Bluesky 协议服务上线
items.summary_en: Bluesky launches Protocol Services to host protocol features in the cloud, letting developers run services that implement the AT Protocol rather than hard-coding clients. The move could improve interoperability and developer flexibility, but introduces questions about trust, data locality, and security.
items.summary_zh: Bluesky 推出协议服务，允许在云端托管并运行实现 AT Protocol 的服务，提升跨应用互操作性与开发者灵活性，同时引发信任、数据归属与安全等议题。

items.title_en: Unsloth Qwen3.8-27B GGUF files
items.title_zh: Unsloth Qwen3.8-27B GGUF 文件
items.summary_en: Unsloth releases Qwen3.8-27B GGUF files, enabling efficient loading and inference on compatible runtimes, expanding accessible options for running the model.
items.summary_zh: Unsloth 发布 Qwen3.8-27B 的 GGUF 文件，提升在兼容运行时上的加载与推理效率，扩展使用选项。

items.title_en: Donkey.bas is 45 Years Old – 131 line of Glory
items.title_zh: Donkey.bas 已有 45 年——131 行的荣耀
items.summary_en: Donkey.bas turns 45, celebrated as a 131-line BASIC game that exemplifies minimalism and longevity in software. The post reflects on how tiny programs can still inspire modern retro or minimalist game design and learning.
items.summary_zh: Donkey.bas 的 45 年纪念聚焦于这段131行的 BASIC 小程序如何成为极简主义与持续影响力的典范。它揭示微小代码也能激发现代创作与学习灵感。

items.title_en: NP-overrated
items.title_zh: NP-被高估了吗
items.summary_en: A provocative take arguing that the significance of NP problems is overstated in practical computing, urging researchers to focus on real-world constraints.
items.summary_zh: 一个挑衅性的观点，认为在实际计算中 NP 问题的重要性被高估，呼吁把研究焦点放在真实世界的约束上。

items.title_en: WhatCable: Know what your USB-C cable can do
items.title_zh: WhatCable：了解你的 USB-C 线能做什么
items.summary_en: WhatCable provides a simple way to verify a USB-C cable's capabilities, including power delivery, data speeds, and alt modes, helping users avoid underperforming cables. It emphasizes the hidden capabilities of cables and the importance of standards-compliant testing for hardware compatibility.
items.summary_zh: WhatCable 提供简单的方法来核实 USB-C 线的性能，例如供电、数据传输速率和备用模式，帮助用户避免买到性能不足的线缆。强调了解线缆隐藏能力和确保兼容性的测试要点。

items.title_en: AI Model Atlas – visualizing populations of ML models as interconnected 3D graph
items.title_zh: AI Model Atlas：将 ML 模型族群可视化为互联的三维图谱
items.summary_en: AI Model Atlas visualizes populations of ML models as interconnected 3D graphs, helping researchers understand model ecosystems, lineage, and cross-model relationships.
items.summary_zh: AI Model Atlas 将大量 ML 模型及其关系以三维图形方式呈现，帮助研究者理解模型生态、谱系与相互关系。

items.title_en: Single log line is 49KB+ (ext4) / 110KB+ (btrfs) of systemd-journald disk writes
items.title_zh: systemd 日志单行在 ext4/btrfs 下的极大写入
items.summary_en: Notes that a single systemd-journald log line can trigger very large disk writes on ext4 and btrfs. This has implications for log throughput, storage planning, and how journaling backends should handle extreme entries.
items.summary_zh: 指出 systemd-journald 的单条日志行在 ext4 下会触发极大的磁盘写入，在 btrfs 下也如此。这对日志吞吐、存储规划以及日志后端处理极端日志条目提出了考虑。

items.title_en: A Contract-Grade Verifier for LLM-Generated GPU Kernels
items.title_zh: 面向合同级别的 LLM 生成 GPU 内核验证器
items.summary_en: A contract-grade verifier for LLM-generated GPU kernels demonstrates formal methods to certify correctness of AI-generated code, raising confidence in deployment. It highlights safety in ML-assisted code generation.
items.summary_zh: 面向 LLM 生成的 GPU 内核的合同级别验证器展示了用于证明正确性的形式方法，提升对 AI 生成代码在实际部署中的信心和安全性。

items.title_en: Ntfy – open-source Push to Mobile
items.title_zh: Ntfy：开源推送至移动端
items.summary_en: Ntfy is an open-source push notification server and client ecosystem, enabling self-hosted, private notifications to mobile devices with lightweight clients and simple API. It’s attractive for teams seeking privacy-respecting, offline-first messaging without vendor lock-in.
items.summary_zh: Ntfy 是一个开源推送通知服务器及客户端生态，支持自托管、私有通知推送到移动端，API 简单且轻量。对追求隐私、离线优先且不依赖厂商锁定的团队尤为有吸引力。

items.title_en: Where did the old web go? We followed 657,607 links to find out
items.title_zh: 旧网站去了哪儿？我们追踪了657,607条链接来找答案
items.summary_en: A long-form audit of the web's link rot by tracing hundreds of thousands of links. The findings illustrate the fragility of the link graph and the enduring importance of archiving for preserving web history.
items.summary_zh: 通过追踪数十万条链接的毁坏情况，揭示了网页链接结构的脆弱性。研究强调在数字记忆和档案保存中，链接的长期可持续性有多重要。

items.title_en: SparrowMap – Cameras that watch government vehicles
items.title_zh: SparrowMap：监控政府车辆的摄像头
items.summary_en: Public-facing map reveals cameras that monitor government vehicles, enabling quick insight into where surveillance happens. It demonstrates how community-facing mapping can shed light on law-enforcement visibility while raising privacy and safety concerns for those tracked.
items.summary_zh: 公开的地图揭示监控政府车辆的摄像头，能让人直观了解监控覆盖的区域。此类开源映射工具有助于提升政府透明度，但也引发隐私与安全方面的担忧。

items.title_en: France's tax authority had data stolen on 680k taxpayers
items.title_zh: 法国税务局数据被窃：68万名纳税人信息被盗
items.summary_en: France's tax authority suffered a data breach exposing sensitive taxpayer information for about 680,000 individuals, highlighting persistent government cybersecurity risk and the human impact of breaches. The incident underscores the need for robust access controls, monitoring, and rapid breach notification.
items.summary_zh: 法国税务局披露约 68 万名纳税人敏感信息被窃，凸显政府级别的网络安全风险及对个人的潜在影响。事件强调加强访问控制、监控和快速披露的重要性。

items.title_en: How Compaction Works in Pi
items.title_zh: Pi 中的压缩如何工作
items.summary_en: Describes how data compaction works in Pi, outlining techniques to reduce storage while maintaining acceptable fidelity.
items.summary_zh: 介绍 Pi 中的数据压缩/紧凑化工作原理，概述在保持可接受保真度的前提下降低存储需求的做法。文中讨论了块级共享、编码方案，以及压缩比与访问速度之间的权衡。

items.title_en: Blog about things you don't understand yet
items.title_zh: 关于你尚未理解的事物的博客
items.summary_en: Blog about things you don't understand yet
items.summary_zh: 探索将尚未理解的事物作为学习之路，强调好奇心与成长在科技领域的重要性。

items.title_en: HashAgent – Share an AI agent as a URL, runs locally via WebGPU
items.title_zh: HashAgent：以 URL 分享 AI 代理，本地通过 WebGPU 运行
items.summary_en: HashAgent lets you publish an AI agent as a shareable URL that runs entirely in your browser, using WebGPU for acceleration and keeping data local. It reduces central hosting risks, boosts privacy, and enables quick sharing of interactive AI agents without server-side inference.
items.summary_zh: HashAgent 允许将一个 AI 代理以可分享的链接发布，在本地浏览器中运行并依靠 WebGPU 加速，数据不离开本机。此方式降低了对服务器端推断的依赖，提升隐私保护，同时方便快速分享可交互的 AI 代理。

items.title_en: Choosing an AI model: one prompt, 11 models, different results
items.title_zh: 同一提示下 11 个模型输出迥异
items.summary_en: An experiment compares a single prompt across 11 AI models, revealing substantial variability in outputs. The findings stress model selection as a critical variable for product teams.
items.summary_zh: 一项实验在同一提示下对 11 个 AI 模型进行比较，结果显示输出差异巨大。研究强调模型选择是产品团队需要重点关注的变量。

items.title_en: Kubernetes on Oxide: How customer needs shaped our integrations
items.title_zh: Oxide 上的 Kubernetes：客户需求如何塑造我们的集成
items.summary_en: This piece explains how customer needs influenced Oxide's Kubernetes integrations, reflecting how a hardware-focused platform balances Kubernetes standards with real-world constraints. It offers insights into tailoring orchestration for edge and dense hardware scenarios.
items.summary_zh: 本文阐述了客户需求如何影响 Oxide 的 Kubernetes 集成，展示了面向硬件的平台如何在遵循 Kubernetes 标准与现实约束之间取得平衡。为在边缘与密集硬件场景中定制编排提供了见解。

items.title_en: Ruby 4.0 Universal RCE Deserialization Gadget Chain
items.title_zh: Ruby 4.0 通用远程代码执行反序列化 gadget 链
items.summary_en: A critical security write-up reveals a universal gadget chain in Ruby 4.0 enabling remote code execution via deserialization. It underscores the dangers of deserializing untrusted data and prompts developers to avoid risky constructs or harden against gadget chains in libraries.
items.summary_zh: 一篇关键安全分析揭示 Ruby 4.0 中存在的通用 gadget 链，可能通过反序列化实现远程代码执行。这凸显了不信任数据反序列化的风险，敦促开发者避免易受 gadget 链影响的用法并对库进行加固。

items.title_en: How Organizations Use AI: Evidence from ChatGPT [pdf]
items.title_zh: 组织如何使用AI：基于ChatGPT的证据（PDF）
items.summary_en: The PDF collects empirical evidence on how organizations deploy ChatGPT, revealing common use cases like customer support and knowledge work. It documents adoption patterns, governance practices, and the tradeoffs between productivity gains and risks such as data leakage and misalignment. The takeaway is that successful AI adoption hinges on structured evaluation, policy controls, and cross-functional collaboration.
items.summary_zh: 该 PDF 汇总了组织部署 ChatGPT 的实证证据，揭示了客户支持与知识工作等常见用例。它记录了采用模式、治理做法，以及生产力提升与数据泄露、目标错位等风险之间的权衡。关键在于成功落地依赖于结构化评估、政策控制和跨职能协作。

items.title_en: How Gödel's Proof Works (2020)
items.title_zh: 哥德尔证明如何起作用（2020）
items.summary_en: The article unpacks Gödel's incompleteness theorem in accessible terms, showing how self-reference and arithmetization create a fundamental limit on provability. It also places the result in the context of mathematics, logic, and AI, illustrating why these limits matter for formal systems and algorithms. Understanding this helps frame debates about consistency, completeness, and the limits of automated reasoning.
items.summary_zh: 文章用通俗方式梳理哥德尔不完备定理，展示自指和算术化如何在形式系统中造成可证明性的根本极限。并将这一结果放在数学、逻辑与人工智能的语境中，解释这些限制为何影响算法与形式系统设计。理解这一点有助于认识一致性、完备性以及自动推理的边界。

items.title_en: Text AI watermarks will always be trivial to remove
items.title_zh: 文本 AI 水印总是容易被移除
items.summary_en: Text AI watermarks will always be trivial to remove
items.summary_zh: 认为文本 AI 水印在实际应用中仍然脆弱，容易被移除，这对署名与检测提出了现实挑战。

items.title_en: AI At Home Part 1: A Box Of Scraps
items.title_zh: 家庭 AI 第1部分：一箱碎片
items.summary_en: Part 1 of a home AI series documents building an AI setup from scavenged hardware, detailing bottlenecks, power use, and pragmatic limits. It provides practical lessons for hobbyists who want hands-on AI without enterprise-grade gear.
items.summary_zh: 家庭 AI 系列第一部分记录从废旧硬件组装 AI 环境的过程，讨论瓶颈、功耗与现实约束。为热衷者提供了“在家也能玩转 AI”的实用经验。

items.title_en: Heart aerospace completes first flight of largest electric aircraft
items.title_zh: Heart Aerospace 完成全球最大电动飞机首飞
items.summary_en: Heart Aerospace has completed the first flight of what they claim is the world’s largest electric aircraft. The milestone underscores progress in electrified aviation, while also underscoring the regulatory, battery, and safety hurdles still ahead for widespread adoption.
items.summary_zh: Heart Aerospace 已完成全球最大电动飞机的首飞里程碑。这标志着电动航空的进展，但也暴露出监管、电池与安全等领域在大规模落地前仍需克服的挑战。

items.title_en: 'Not acceptable': Judge orders Google to make rival app store installs easier
items.title_zh: “不可接受”裁定：法院命令谷歌简化对手应用商店安装
items.summary_en: A court ruling requires Google to ease the process for installing apps from rival app stores, pushing for interoperability and fair competition in mobile ecosystems. The decision could shift developer and device-maker strategies around app distribution.
items.summary_zh: 法院裁定要求谷歌简化来自对手应用商店的应用安装流程，推动移动生态的互操作性与公平竞争。此举可能改变开发者和设备厂商在应用分发方面的策略。

items.title_en: Launch HN: Bullet (YC S26) – A Faster Coding Agent
items.title_zh: Launch HN：Bullet（YC S26）— 更快的编码代理
items.summary_en: Bullet, a YC S26 startup, markets a faster coding agent designed to accelerate development through smarter context handling and automation. It represents a growing class of AI-assisted coding assistants trying to outpace traditional tooling.
items.summary_zh: Bullet 作为 YC S26 项目，声称提供更快的编码代理，通过更智能的上下文处理和自动化来提升编码效率。代表正在兴起的 AI 辅助编码工具群体。

items.title_en: Show HN: Lumabri – Run Moe Models on a P2P Swarm with Colibri
items.title_zh: Show HN：Lumabri——在 Colibri 架构的点对点大群中运行 Moe 模型
items.summary_en: Lumabri runs moe-models (small anime-style models) across a P2P swarm using Colibri, enabling distributed inference without centralized servers. This approach improves privacy and resilience while showcasing a path to decentralized ML tooling.
items.summary_zh: Lumabri 通过 Colibri 在点对点群体中分发运行 moe 模型，实现去中心化推断。该方案提升隐私性与鲁棒性，同时展示了实现去中心化机器学习工具的可能路径。

items.title_en: Tocharian Online
items.title_zh: Tocharian 在线资源
items.summary_en: Tocharian Online makes Tocharian texts accessible online with scholarly apparatus, offering a searchable corpus for linguists. The resource lowers entry barriers for studying this extinct language branch and demonstrates how digital humanities compounds research.
items.summary_zh: Tocharian Online 将 Tocharian 文献数字化并在线提供，配有注释与检索工具，方便语言学研究。该资源降低了研究门槛，推动数字人文发展。

items.title_en: S.F.'s top-paid employee made $900K. Here's what every city worker gets paid
items.title_zh: 旧金山城市员工薪资全景：最高薪约 90 万美元
items.summary_en: San Francisco's public pay data reveals a wide salary spectrum, with a top-paid employee approaching $900k. The dataset informs debates on public compensation, cost of living, and transparency in city governance.
items.summary_zh: 公开薪资数据揭示薪酬差异，最高薪员工接近 90 万美元。该数据为公共薪酬、生活成本与政府透明度的讨论提供实证依据。

items.title_en: GoAccess – Open-source real-time log analyzer and interactive viewer
items.title_zh: GoAccess：开源实时日志分析与交互查看工具
items.summary_en: GoAccess provides real-time, open-source log analytics with an interactive terminal viewer, making it easy to inspect server traffic and detect anomalies without heavy tooling. It's a lightweight staple for ops monitoring.
items.summary_zh: GoAccess 作为开源工具，提供实时日志分析和交互查看，适合快速排错与监控。轻量级且上手简单，是运维的常备利器。

items.title_en: I want extern "fil-C"
items.title_zh: 我想要 extern "fil-C"
items.summary_en: I want extern "fil-C"
items.summary_zh: 讨论在名为 fil-C 的语言上下文中使用 extern "C" 的可能性，以避免在 C 与其他语言链接时符号名称改编。

items.title_en: JDK 27 G1/Parallel/Serial GC Changes
items.title_zh: JDK 27：G1/Parallel/Serial GC 变更
items.summary_en: JDK 27 introduces GC changes across G1, Parallel, and Serial collectors, aiming to reduce pause times and improve throughput in varied workloads. The updates influence tuning choices for large JVM deployments.
items.summary_zh: JDK 27 对 G1、Parallel 与 Serial GC 做出改动，目标是缩短停顿时间并提升吞吐，影响大规模 JVM 部署的调优策略。

items.title_en: How art invented humanity
items.title_zh: 艺术如何成就人类
items.summary_en: Aeon essay argues that art is not just a human invention but a driving force shaping cognition and culture; it reframes art as an enabling force in human evolution and social life. The piece invites readers to rethink AI creativity through that lens.
items.summary_zh: Aeon 文章提出艺术不仅是人类发明，更是驱动认知和文化演化的力量。用这一视角重新思考 AI 创造力及其可能的社会意义。

items.title_en: Don't classify, hallucinate
items.title_zh: 别再做分类，别让模型产生幻觉！
items.summary_en: The piece argues that forcing ML models into rigid classification tasks can degrade usefulness and invites embracing generative approaches with guardrails. It highlights practical strategies to reduce hallucinations, including prompt design, transparency, and testing against real-world distributions.
items.summary_zh: 文中强调将模型置于僵硬的分类任务容易放大错误，鼓励在某些场景采用生成性方法并设置防错边界。提出通过提示设计、结果透明、基于实际分布的测试等手段来降低幻觉风险。

items.title_en: Turbo Pascal on CP/M, MSX-DOS and MS-DOS
items.title_zh: Turbo Pascal 在 CP/M、MSX-DOS 与 MS-DOS 上的实现——小型机上的 Pascal
items.summary_en: Turbo Pascal ran on CP/M, MSX-DOS, and MS-DOS, showing Pascal’s reach on small machines. The write-up traces porting efforts, constraints of 8-bit systems, and how this shaped early software development.
items.summary_zh: Turbo Pascal 能在 CP/M、MSX-DOS 与 MS-DOS 上运行，体现了 Pascal 对小型机的覆盖。文中回顾移植过程、8 位系统的限制，以及对早期软件开发的影响。

items.title_en: Mushroom behind 'tiny people' hallucinations identified
items.title_zh: 识别出引发小人幻觉的蘑菇
items.summary_en: Researchers have identified the mushroom species behind reports of tiny people hallucinations during certain psychedelic experiences. The finding sheds light on how specific compounds reshape visual perception, with implications for safety, medical research, and foragers' awareness.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员已确定在某些迷幻体验中引发小人幻觉的蘑菇种类。该发现揭示了特定成分如何改变视觉感知，为安全使用、药物研究和野外采集者的认知提高了理解。

items.title_en: Show HN: C# Game Engine with its own scripting language and IDE
items.title_zh: Show HN：带自研脚本语言与 IDE 的 C# 游戏引擎
items.summary_en: A Show HN feature presenting a C# game engine that ships with its own scripting language and integrated IDE. The project showcases a DIY, self-contained toolchain aimed at speeding game development and lowering entry barriers for experimentation.
items.summary_zh: 展览式分享展示了一款用 C# 编写的游戏引擎，内置自研脚本语言和集成开发环境。该项目体现了一条自建工具链的思路，意在加速游戏开发并降低尝试门槛。

items.title_en: A humble cabbage became one of the Forbidden City’s treasures (2025)
items.title_zh: 一颗普通白菜成为故宫珍宝之一（2025）
items.summary_en: Profile of the jadeite cabbage artifact and its cultural significance, explaining why this humble sculpture became a treasured symbol in the Forbidden City by 2025.
items.summary_zh: 聚焦故宫的玉白菜文物及其在2025年的收藏价值与文化意义，解释为何这一常见形象成为国宝中的重要代表。

items.title_en: Differential Heuristics
items.title_zh: 差分启发式算法
items.summary_en: A deep dive into using differential heuristics to guide search or optimization, allowing more accurate or faster estimates by comparing neighboring states. It shows practical examples in pathfinding or AI planning, and how small perturbations yield better pruning.
items.summary_zh: 介绍如何通过对相邻状态估值的对比使用差分启发式来提升搜索和规划效率，能更快地做出更准确的剪枝判断。结合路径查找等场景给出实际应用与实现要点。

items.title_en: Better Gaussian Splatting in Julia
items.title_zh: 在 Julia 中实现更好的高斯喷溅法
items.summary_en: It highlights how language-specific optimizations can yield tangible gains in graphics and ML tooling.
items.summary_zh: 文章介绍在 Julia 中改进高斯喷溅法，旨在提升渲染效果或点云可视化性能，展示语言层优化如何带来显著的图形与机器学习工具改进。

items.title_en: Ultraviolet Bird Photography
items.title_zh: 紫外线鸟类摄影
items.summary_en: Ultraviolet Bird Photography showcases techniques for capturing birds illuminated by ultraviolet light, including gear choices, exposure settings, and post-processing tricks to reveal plumage not visible to the naked eye.
items.summary_zh: 《紫外线鸟类摄影》展示在紫外线光照下拍摄鸟类的技巧，涵盖器材、曝光设置与后期处理，揭示肉眼看不到的羽毛细节。

items.title_en: Finite State Machines in Forth (1994)
items.title_zh: Forth 中的有限状态机（1994）
items.summary_en: Finite State Machines in Forth (1994)
items.summary_zh: 回顾性笔记，讲述在 Forth 中实现有限状态机，展示紧凑、可移植的状态机以及与主流语言不同的编程范式。

items.title_en: Show HN: Ember – Redshift safe color palettes
items.title_zh: Ember——适用于 Redshift 的安全调色板
items.summary_en: Ember is a collection of color palettes designed to be safe for Redshift rendering, emphasizing colorblind accessibility and perceptual uniformity. It helps data viz creators avoid misleading palettes and speeds up choosing ready-to-use schemes.
items.summary_zh: Ember 提供一组适合 Redshift 渲染的调色板，强调色盲友好与感知一致性，帮助数据可视化设计者避免误导性配色并快速选用现成配色。

items.title_en: We're not done with point clouds
items.title_zh: 点云技术仍未完结
items.summary_en: Argues that point clouds remain a robust, evolving data primitive in 3D sensing and graphics, with advances in processing, streaming, and compression continuing to enable real-time interaction and scalable visualization.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为点云仍是三维感知与渲染的核心数据结构，随着处理、流式传输和压缩技术的进步，实时交互和大规模可视化将变得更高效。介绍了新的方法和日益完善的生态系统。

items.title_en: an ambiguity in C89 which will never be fixed
items.title_zh: C89 标准中的一个永远无法解决的歧义
items.summary_en: An ambiguity in c89 which will never be fixed
items.summary_zh: 探讨 C89 标准中的长期歧义，难以修正，对编译器行为和跨平台可移植性产生影响。

items.title_en: Super Mario Derivations
items.title_zh: 《超级马里奥》衍生作品
items.summary_en: A look at derivative works and experiments inspired by Super Mario, from mods to procedural level ideas. The collection showcases how iconic games inspire new design experiments and community creativity.
items.summary_zh: 聚焦受《超级马里奥》启发的衍生作品与实验，从游戏模组到关卡生成的创意展示。集合显示了经典作品如何激发社区创新与设计探索。

items.title_en: The Library of Ashurbanipal (2025)
items.title_zh: 阿舒巴尼帕尔藏书（2025）
items.summary_en: This feature revisits the ancient Library of Ashurbanipal in Nineveh, highlighting how its clay tablets preserved Mesopotamian knowledge across genres from literature to science. It also covers discovery, organization, and ongoing scholarship that continues to illuminate ancient texts.
items.summary_zh: 该篇回顾尼尼微的阿舒巴尼帕尔藏书，强调泥板文献在文学、科学等领域所载的美索不达米亚知识。文章还探讨了馆藏的发现、整理，以及对古文本持续的学术研究与解读。

items.title_en: The Legend of the Novell NE2000 [video]
items.title_zh: 诺维尔 NE2000 的传说 [视频]
items.summary_en: A retro-tech video recounts the lore of the Novell NE2000 Ethernet NIC, a simple, widely-adopted network card whose open hardware and straightforward drivers helped standardize early PC networking. It looks at why the NE2000 endured and its influence on compatibility.
items.summary_zh: 这段复古科技视频讲述了诺维尔 NE2000 以太网网卡的传奇。凭借简易的设计和开源硬件，成为早期 PC 网络的标准之一，并影响了后续的兼容性与驱动模型。

items.title_en: Idol Mahjong Final Romance: A Slideshow Disguised as a Video Game
items.title_zh: 偶像麻将最终恋情：伪装成电子游戏的幻灯片
items.summary_en: The piece argues that Idol Mahjong Final Romance is essentially a slideshow masquerading as a video game, using Mahjong idol aesthetics to entice rather than provide meaningful interactivity. The article riffs on the mismatch between glossy packaging and limited gameplay.
items.summary_zh: 指出《偶像麻将最终恋情》本质上是一部伪装成电子游戏的幻灯片展示，以偶像麻将美学吸引玩家而非提供真正的互动。文章还嘲讽其华丽包装与有限游戏性的错配。

items.title_en: Moving integer division to floating-point is trivial
items.title_zh: 将整数除法移到浮点运算其实很简单
items.summary_en: Comparing integer division with floating-point reveals that, in many algorithms, a simple FP-based approach reduces edge-case handling and may improve readability, albeit with precision tradeoffs to consider.
items.summary_zh: 将整数除法改为浮点除法在不少算法中可简化边界处理和代码可读性，尽管需权衡精度与性能的取舍。

items.title_en: Protect Your Relays
items.title_zh: 保护你的中继节点
items.summary_en: It covers practical measures like authenticated relays, cryptographic signing, and monitoring to ensure trusted routing.
items.summary_zh: 文中强调保护中继节点，防止篡改与滥用，提出对中继网络进行身份认证和完整性校验的必要性。给出可行的做法，如对中继进行认证、签名和监控以确保可信路由。

items.title_en: Show HN: Lambdock – Wayland-native GTK4 dock with a live Lisp REPL
items.title_zh: Show HN：Lambdock——Wayland 原生 GTK4 桌面托架，内置实时 Lisp REPL
items.summary_en: Lambdock is a Wayland-native dock built with GTK4 that includes a live Lisp REPL, enabling live experimentation and extensibility in the shell/desktop environment. It demonstrates how minimal, extensible UI components can empower power users to prototype and customize workflows in real time.
items.summary_zh: Lambdock 是一个 Wayland 原生的 GTK4 桌面托架，内置实时 Lisp REPL，方便用户边运行边定制工作流。这个项目展示了以最小化、可扩展的 UI 组件来赋能高级用户进行实时原型开发和自定义。

items.title_en: Gödel, Escher, Elisp: The Beauty of Macros
items.title_zh: Gödel、Escher、Elisp：宏的美
items.summary_en: Gödel, Escher, Elisp explores macro-powered metaprogramming in Lisp with examples inspired by the famous works, illustrating how macros unlock expressive software design.
items.summary_zh: 《 Gödel、Escher、Elisp 》通过受哥德尔-艾舍尔-巴赫启发的例子，展示 Lisp 宏如何驱动元编程与高表达力的设计。

items.title_en: What an improv stage can teach you about leading cross-cultural teams in Tokyo
items.title_zh: 即兴舞台能教你在东京领导跨文化团队的道理
items.summary_en: An article argues that improv stage dynamics translate into practical leadership skills for cross-cultural teams, especially in Tokyo's multinational workspace. It emphasizes listening, adaptability, and a 'yes, and' mindset to bridge communication gaps.
items.summary_zh: 文章指出即兴表演的互动模式能落地为跨文化团队的领导技巧，尤其在东京的多元工作环境中更具价值。强调倾听、快速适应以及跟进式的“先接受再扩展”思维以缩小沟通鸿沟。

items.title_en: Cave of the Crystals
items.title_zh: 晶体洞穴
items.summary_en: The Cave of the Crystals hosts some of the largest natural gypsum crystals, formed under extreme conditions in a Mexican mine. Access is perilous due to heat and humidity, but the site provides unique insights into mineral formation and subterranean geology.
items.summary_zh: 晶体洞穴拥有地球上最巨大的天然石膏晶体之一，形成于墨西哥矿井的极端环境中。由于高温高湿，探访极具危险，但为矿物生长与地下地质提供了独特洞见。
